newsitem.title: USA: CCAIR March load factor squeaks to 47.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: CCAIR March load factor squeaks to 47.9 pct.

text.p: CCAIR Inc said Monday its March load factor increased slightly to 47.9 percent from 47.5 percent in March 1996.

CCAIR said reductions in passengers, revenue passenger miles (RPMs) and available seat miles (ASMs) were due to the elimination of unprofitable flights, which will improve reliability and on-time performance.
CCAIR said revenue passenger miles in March fell 4.8 percent to 12.0 million from 12.6 million in March 1996 and available seat miles fell 5.7 percent to 24.9 million from 26.4 million a year ago.
In the year-to-date period, the load factor increased to 45.1 percent from 44.5 percent in the first three months of 1996, CCAIR said.

Revenue passenger miles fell to 31.9 million from 32.2 million in the year-to-date period, CCAIR said. Available seat miles fell to 70.6 million in the first three months of the year from 72.4 million in the year ago period, CCAIR said.
